description: This file defines the SelectAppsView class, a custom Android view for selecting installed applications, including filtering and managing app selection states.

classes.name: SelectAppsView
classes.description: A custom Android view for selecting installed applications with filtering capabilities.

classes.name: AppListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying and filtering the list of installed apps.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application with package name and label.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Initializes the list view and adapter after layout inflation.

methods.name: setCurrentFilterString
methods.description: Sets the filter string for app search.

methods.name: toggleAppSelected
methods.description: Toggles selection state of an app based on its position.

methods.name: afterAppsLoaded
methods.description: Marks apps as selected if they are in the swap list after loading.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view for an app.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds app data to the list item view.

methods.name: setSearchTerm
methods.description: Filters the app list based on the search term.

methods.name: getInflater
methods.description: Provides a LayoutInflater with a specific theme.

methods.name: getDefaultAppIcon
methods.description: Returns a default icon for apps without a specific icon.
